description: This file contains low-level assembly routines for context switching, system call handling, and user space entry in the Zephyr RTOS on x86 IA-32 architecture, including KPTI (Kernel Page Table Isolation) support.

methods.name: z_x86_trampoline_to_kernel
methods.description: Assembly routine to switch from user mode to kernel mode, switching page tables and stacks.

methods.name: z_x86_trampoline_to_user
methods.description: Assembly routine to switch from kernel mode to user mode, restoring user context.

methods.name: z_x86_trampoline_to_user_always
methods.description: Assembly routine to switch to user mode with context copying and stack switching.

methods.name: z_x86_syscall_entry_stub
methods.description: Entry point for system call handling, marshaling arguments and dispatching to handlers.

methods.name: arch_user_string_nlen
methods.description: Assembly function to compute the length of a user-space string with fault handling.

methods.name: z_x86_userspace_enter
methods.description: Assembly routine to transition from kernel to user space, setting up user thread context.
